summary:
Salesforce 本季 EPS 大幅超預期逾24%，營收年增13%，AI Agentforce 動能延續。
• EPS 3.88 美元，較預估3.13大幅超出24.07%。
• 營收11.13億美元（B級），年增13.27%維持雙位數成長。
• 本益比19.24，在大型 SaaS 中相對不高，估值具吸引力。
• Agentforce 等 AI 產品逐步貢獻，帶動利潤率改善。
ai_view:
訊號偏正面：連續兩季 EPS 超預期逾24%，反映利潤率紀律與 AI 產品初步變現。短期股價有支撐，惟13%營收成長已從過往高速放緩，中期關鍵在 Agentforce 能否轉為實質 ARR 增量。追蹤指標：當前剩餘履約義務（cRPO）、訂閱毛利率、Data Cloud 與 AI 付費客戶數。估值本益比19.24在同業偏低，若成長重新加速，重評價空間明確。

需留意：企業 IT 支出若放緩，訂閱續約與新單成長承壓。；AI 變現節奏不確定，市場對 Agentforce 預期偏高。；雲端 SaaS 競爭激烈，定價與獲客成本受壓。

summary_en:
Salesforce crushed EPS estimates by over 24% with 13% revenue growth, as Agentforce AI momentum continued.
• EPS of $3.88 beat the $3.13 estimate by 24.07%.
• Revenue of $11.13B grew 13.27% year over year, sustaining double-digit growth.
• P/E of 19.24 is relatively modest among large-cap SaaS names.
• AI products such as Agentforce are increasingly contributing and lifting margins.
ai_view_zh:
訊號偏正面：連續兩季 EPS 超預期逾24%，反映利潤率紀律與 AI 產品初步變現。短期股價有支撐，惟13%營收成長已從過往高速放緩，中期關鍵在 Agentforce 能否轉為實質 ARR 增量。追蹤指標：當前剩餘履約義務（cRPO）、訂閱毛利率、Data Cloud 與 AI 付費客戶數。估值本益比19.24在同業偏低，若成長重新加速，重評價空間明確。

需留意：企業 IT 支出若放緩，訂閱續約與新單成長承壓。；AI 變現節奏不確定，市場對 Agentforce 預期偏高。；雲端 SaaS 競爭激烈，定價與獲客成本受壓。
ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: two straight quarters of 24%-plus EPS beats reflect margin discipline and early AI monetization. The stock has near-term support, though 13% revenue growth has decelerated from prior highs. The mid-term hinges on whether Agentforce converts into incremental ARR. Track cRPO, subscription gross margin, and Data Cloud/AI paying-customer counts. A P/E of 19.24 is low for the peer group, leaving rerating room if growth reaccelerates.

Watch：A slowdown in enterprise IT spending could pressure renewals and new bookings.; AI monetization pace is uncertain while Agentforce expectations run high.; Intense cloud SaaS competition pressures pricing and customer acquisition costs.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 較預估高出24.07%，營收年增13.27%顯示需求穩健。
